notes: Use group.name for chemist-facing labels (Ar-, Vinyl-, -CHO, -CN, -NO2, -B(OH)2, -Bpin, -OTf, ...).
Use group.id as a stable, code-friendly key.
Context groups represent the attachment environment; core/tail groups represent substituent cores.

groups.name: Ar-
groups.description: Aryl attachment via aromatic carbon (Ar-).

groups.name: Arom-
groups.description: Any aromatic attachment (includes heteroaromatic attachment via any aromatic atom).

groups.name: Vinyl-
groups.description: Vinylic (alkenyl) attachment at an sp2 carbon.

groups.name: R-
groups.description: Alkyl (sp3 carbon) attachment point (R-).

groups.name: Bn-
groups.description: Benzylic CH2 attachment (Bn-).

groups.name: Allyl-
groups.description: Allylic CH2 attachment (Allyl-).

groups.name: Alkynyl-
groups.description: Alkynyl attachment at a carbon in a C#C unit (general; internal/terminal).

groups.name: Acyl-
groups.description: Acyl carbon attachment point (Acyl-), used for acyl electrophiles/features.

groups.name: -Cl
groups.description: Chloro substituent core (-Cl).

groups.name: -Br
groups.description: Bromo substituent core (-Br).

groups.name: -I
groups.description: Iodo substituent core (-I).

groups.name: -F
groups.description: Fluoro substituent core (-F).

groups.name: -CHO
groups.description: Aldehyde core; attach via formyl carbon (-CHO).

groups.name: -CN
groups.description: Nitrile core; attach via cyano carbon (-CN).

groups.name: -NO2
groups.description: Nitro core; attach via nitro nitrogen (-NO2).

groups.name: -B(OH)2
groups.description: Boronic acid core; attach via boron (-B(OH)2).

groups.name: -Bpin
groups.description: Bpin core; attach via boron (-Bpin).

groups.name: -NH2
groups.description: Primary amine N core (-NH2).

groups.name: -NHR
groups.description: Secondary amine N core with one N-H (-NHR).

groups.name: -NR2
groups.description: Tertiary amine N core, no N-H (-NR2).

groups.name: -OH
groups.description: Hydroxy core (-OH).

groups.name: -SH
groups.description: Thiol core (-SH).

groups.name: -CO2H
groups.description: Carboxylic acid core (-CO2H), attach via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -COCl
groups.description: Acyl chloride core (-COCl), attach via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -CO2R
groups.description: Ester core (-CO2R), attach via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -CONHR
groups.description: Amide with N-H (generic -CONHR/-CONH2); attach via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -OTf
groups.description: Triflate tail for Ar-OTf/Vinyl-OTf via oxygen linker.

groups.name: -OTs
groups.description: Tosylate tail via oxygen linker.

groups.name: -OMs
groups.description: Mesylate tail via oxygen linker.
